text.en:
A national vocational school to be known as the Basilan National Agro-Industrial shall be
established in the province of Basilan.

The Secretary of Education and Culture is hereby authorized to organize said school
accordingly.

The sums of six hundred and fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of
any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and
maintenance of said school during the current fiscal year. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for its
operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriation measure.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th day of February in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
